runtime_license_boundary.detail: The strict MIT/Apache-2.0 Cargo package audits and selected-source guards pass without exceptions. The known futures-channel BSD queue was replaced by an original synchronized FIFO; retained upstream files and replacement hashes are guarded. Current static core 3f06f4ac passed 31 container and 29 HTTPS checks. It still contains non-allowlisted Rust Unicode data, while libc, unwind, compiler-builtins and startup inputs remain incompletely reviewed. GNU candidate 2df83ea9 uses separate external runtime infrastructure and passed source inventory, numerical, TLS, 31 container and 29 HTTPS checks. Its external std contains non-allowlisted components and must not be bundled. Individual-file exceptions, unmapped or inlined content, external-runtime distribution and production adoption remain uncleared. See licensing.md and runtime-link-audit.md.

jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 106 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core 3f06f4ac passed 31 container and 29 HTTPS checks, including active FFmpeg shutdown and video resume after restart. Twenty-four public studio reads and mutations passed; favorites persisted across a server-container restart. Official web and Qt 6 Desktop displayed local NFO studios and their scoped two-movie view with the default folder sort. Web favorite toggles passed. Native playback of the short silent fixture failed in MPV video-output initialization; a separate fresh OpenGL profile remained blank. Both failures are preserved. Earlier music, artist, album, playlist and native playback observations retain their exact image scopes in acceptance.md. Public Jellyfin 12 observations support studio filename precedence, stored folder sorting, music state, and artist-role/count behavior. Embedded tags, automatic artist creation, ambiguous names, complete recommendation and collection management, studio artwork and virtual enumeration, played-state writes and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain incomplete. General Desktop startup, broader clients, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, audible quality and scale remain unvalidated. Native final-position inconsistency remains unexplained; some user-data writes retain qualified differences from the reference.

feature_acceptance.detail: Feature areas remain partial. See compatibility.md for individual limits.

external_client_and_remote_security.detail: 29 local HTTPS proxy checks passed with synthetic remote addresses. Internet deployment, broader external-client behavior, proxy configurations, and external security review remain incomplete.

operational_scale.detail: Bounded 20,000- and 99,000-file synthetic scanner runs passed. No real-storage 1 PB, billion-file, or thousand-stream load result is available.
